title: Nailed the basics - Simple, minimal, no distractions.
body:
Easily one of the best timers for the Pomodoro technique. 
A hidden gem, really. Might give their counterpart productivity timer apps a run for their money. 
The interface is very easy to use and the app does everything right.
I’m glad that the last update was a couple years ago, it doesn’t need an update. With the added advantage of not being bombarded with ads or  In-App purchases, an ‘adequate’ app in its entirety.   
Hoping that the app continues to exist in its current form even in the far future. :)
author: DrHD07

title: More useful if it had a percent display option
body: I’ve found this a bit useful, but it’s not very good at giving a sense of how far you’ve progressed against your goal - like a quarter, halfway etc, which is much better for motivation. It would be a good feature if there was a display option where the whole color disk is used for the target time you set.

title: simple visual timer...
body:
It is a simple visual timer …. the digital version of the famed Time Timer physical timer. The red time remaining on a white background is a great visual and shows the remaining time at a glance. The new upgraded version is even better than the previous version. It is useful as a aid to do homework for the kids, to encourage them to avoid distractions for the next 20 - 30 minutes set on the timer.
But one gripe with the new version is that the clock face has been made even smaller in the vertical view… it would be nice if it fills most of the screen as in the horizontal view. Hope they update it in future versions.
